description: Draft an AI governance policy for an insurance agency from the public Integrated AI template. Requires agency type (benefits, pc, or both), state, the AI tools in use, and agency size. Fills those fields where the template has a place for them and leaves the agency name in brackets. Not legal advice. Same policy as https://www.integrated-ai.com/resources/ai-governance-policy-template.html.

agency_size.description: Headcount or a band such as 1-10, 11-25, or 26+.

ai_tools.description: AI tools the agency uses, separated by commas.

state.description: US state name or two-letter code, such as IL or Illinois.

name: build_governance_policy
title: Build an AI governance policy
